notes: The current arcade stick whose maker publishes dimensions: HORI's Fighting Stick α for PS5/PS4/PC. The envelope is printed on the product page of its Street Fighter 6 edition SPF-033 (hori.jp/products/p5/spf-033/, released 2023-06-02 per that page); that page's manual link serves the base SPF-013 manual (【JP】spf-013_manual_20231214.pdf), whose spec table prints the same 約2.7kg and 約3.0m and the dimensions in mm (typeset vertically, so the PDF text cannot be quoted byte-exact; the page's centimetre figures are quoted instead). Axis labels are HORI's own: 幅 = width 410, 奥行 = depth 300, 高さ = height 120 (desk footprint 410 x 300, height including the lever). The figures are centimetres and kilograms, so each mm/g value carries a derived source with the exact x10 / x1000 method (brief: a conversion needs tier derived). excludes_projections=false: the page says «（スティックレバーを含む）» (lever included). Controls from the manual's 各部の名称 (PlayStation 5 diagram; PDF lines joined with spaces): lever 1 (スティックレバー（方向キー）); face_button 8 (△ ○ × □ L1 L2 R1 R2, HAYABUSA buttons in the arcade 8-button layout); button 6 = オプション, PS, クリエイト, L3, R3, FUNCTION; touchpad 1 (タッチパッド/タッチパッドボタン). The ハードウェア切替スイッチ and キーロックスイッチ slide switches and the profile/lock LEDs have no controller-contract kind. Ports: the attached USB cable = cable 1 (wired, 3.0 m); ステレオヘッドホン/マイク端子 = headphone_3_5 (diameter not printed; catalog convention). host_console uses the key sony-playstation-5-cfi-1000 (the launch model; any PS5 model hosts it) (also PS4 and PC). Both editions share one shell; SPF-033 differs only in its top artwork, which the catalog never records.
